objective: Check whether the lower-dimensional sparse/Frobenius frontier repeats at n=11 before making an n=17 implementation claim.
schedules: Same exhaustive [0,e,f] schedule search and exact subgroup coverage as the n=17 frontier.
metrics: Same columns, coverage, expected systems, ANF/CNF size and exact membership-clause metrics.
execution: Run end-to-end extraction for the n=11 frontier winner and its polynomial control on three deterministic target streams if the screen finds a nontrivial lower-dimensional point.
claim_boundary: Agreement at n=11 and n=17 supports a small-field implementation pattern; it does not prove asymptotic behavior.
